messages:
ana: Drafting the internal RN for tomorrow's Dedicated rollout. Pasting the microcopy and the pin/deploybot plan. Quick checks please — want to post T-1h.

ana: RN snippet:
```
Redwood Dedicated: improved KV cache warmup and quantized kernels for faster cold-starts.
- Reduced median token latency by ~20% for short prompts.
- Default runtime now prefers the q4f16 profile for <8k sequences; opt-in for q8_0 for high-quality routes.
- Rollout: canary -> staged -> full over 40m; see pinned config.
```

ana: Proposed ops plan:
- Pin model binary: `redwood/model-dedicated@v3.2.1-rc2` (will fallback to `v3.1.8` if pinned job fails)
- Deploybot command (dry-run):
```
/deploy --target dedicated-prod --image redwood/model-dedicated:v3.2.1-rc2 --canary 10%:15m,50%:15m,100%:10m --window 02:00-04:00 UTC --notify #eng-oncall --tag rn-2026-03
```

chris: Quick q — are we pinning at the service level or only the route? If service-level pin, downtime for traffic routing is minimal.

ana: Pinning service-level in the dedicated pool config. Routes with strict SLA will remain on v3.1.8 until full verification.

jess: +1 on fallback to v3.1.8. Add explicit `--fallback-image` in the deploybot command?

ana: good call. I'll add `--fallback redwood/model-dedicated:v3.1.8`.

matt: On-call heads-up: canary schedule works for us. Who's owner for the first 30m? I can take initial 00-30 if needed.

alex: Observability check: need pinned dashboard links in RN (token-latency, kv-hit-rate, error-rate). Also add synthetic check to run at canary start.

ana: Adding monitor links and synthetic. Will attach the dashboard URLs to the internal announce.

deploybot: deploybot: Dry-run OK. Preview of rollout plan:
- Job: rn-2026-03 (dry-run)
- Target: dedicated-prod
- Image: redwood/model-dedicated:v3.2.1-rc2
- Canary: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> 100% for 10m
- Fallback: redwood/model-dedicated:v3.1.8
- Window: 02:00-04:00 UTC

deploybot: Estimated QPS change during canary: +2% tail variance. No infra scaling required.

chris: Rollback criteria proposal (we should agree):
- Error rate increase > 2% absolute and sustained for 5m OR
- P95 latency increase > 600ms sustained 5m OR
- Key synthetic failure (end-to-end prompt mismatch)
If any trigger, auto-rollback to v3.1.8 and page on-call.

jess: Add quick checklist to RN for responders: how to trigger manual rollback (CLI) + contact matrix. Example CLI:
```
/deploy rollback --target dedicated-prod --to-image redwood/model-dedicated:v3.1.8 --reason "rollout-triggered"
```

ana: I'll include that exact snippet and the contact list.

matt: Confirming I take first 30m owner. @sara can you cover 30-60?

sara: Can do 30-60. I'll post the internal announce at T-1h with the RN copy + dashboard links + oncall roster.

alex: One more ask — pin the config key `runtime.q_profile=q4f16` in the deploy manifest for the canary only, so we can flip easily if we need q8_0 later.

ana: Done. Will include manifest diff in the deploybot annotations.

deploybot: Note: If `--canary` stage fails three times, automated rollback will proceed. Manual override requires `--force`.

chris: LGTM for the rollout plan and rollback criteria.

jess: LGTM, thanks.

matt: LGTM. I'll be on standby in #eng-oncall.

ana: Thanks all. Final checklist for internal announce (I'm checking off):
- [x] RN microcopy finalized
- [x] Deploybot command updated with `--fallback` and manifest diff
- [x] Monitors & synthetic checks linked
- [x] On-call handover arranged (matt -> sara)
- [x] Rollback CLI & criteria documented

ana: Posting internal announce at 01:00 UTC. Will ping channel when posted. :thumbsup:

sara: Copy received. I'll amplify to stakeholders once live. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Schedule saved. Next step: `@ana` run `/deploy --confirm rn-2026-03` at T-15m to flip from dry-run to live.`
